objective: Select and integrate the smallest local reasoning model that materially improves autonomous scientific research, hard-case reasoning, critique, and review on the Lambda Vector while preserving existing document-inference and bounded VERIFY capacity.
decision_principles: Size the workload before selecting the model.
Use one shared physical reasoner owner with fresh logical sessions rather than multiple resident replicas.
Do not ask the reasoner to perform deterministic, retrieval, parsing, or specialized document work already handled better elsewhere.
Optimize for false-accept avoidance, provenance fidelity, task completion, and useful work per GPU-second before generic benchmark prestige.
Experimental iteration is single-executor and measurement-driven; failed hypotheses are expected and do not require fresh independent review.
No production routing, scientific authority, or live infrastructure changes are authorized by this design.

bounded_verify_model.role: radius-0 page-scoped VERIFY with whole-job Codex fallthrough

table.residency: mutually exclusive with qwen_verify on GPU 1

qwen_verify.residency: mutually exclusive with table on GPU 1

current_job_graph.note: This is the orchestration-level job bound, not a requirement that every job use the local reasoner.

reasoner_roles.expected_frequency: several calls per long autonomous loop
reasoner_roles.context: checkpoint, tool results, bounded evidence summaries

reasoner_roles.expected_frequency: only unresolved EXTRACT/VERIFY or semantic-control cases
reasoner_roles.context: bounded unresolved regions and exact source locators

reasoner_roles.expected_frequency: 1 synthesis + 1 gap generation per completed checkpoint cycle
at explicit correctness gates, not every iteration
reasoner_roles.context: immutable artifact/evidence packet; no author transcript required

explicitly_not_reasoner_roles: existing bounded Qwen3.5-4B VERIFY unless a later dedicated promotion gate changes it
routine schema validation and deterministic provenance checks

serving_architecture.logical_session_policy: Fresh prompt/context per role invocation; no cross-role hidden conversational state is required.
serving_architecture.overflow: fail/backpressure rather than spawn a duplicate heavyweight owner
serving_architecture.long_context_policy: Do not use 1M-token model context as working memory. Durable research state lives in PostgreSQL/checkpoints/source artifacts; retrieve bounded evidence into the model.

gpu_policy.bakeoff: Exactly one selected GPU visible; no co-resident heavyweight candidate during first quality/resource measurements.
gpu_policy.production_candidate: Family switching/drain-and-evict is preferred over permanent dual-GPU occupation.

first_wave.revision_policy: resolve and freeze immutable upstream revision before any download
first_wave.precision_target: single-GPU quantized text inference; target weight footprint <= 10 GiB
first_wave.reason: Separates the benefit of moving 4B->9B from the benefit of reasoning-trace post-training.

first_wave.revision_policy: resolve and freeze immutable v2 upstream revision before any download
first_wave.precision_target: single-GPU quantized text inference matched as closely as practical to the official 9B control
first_wave.reason: Tests whether post-training on long reasoning/tool-use traces improves the actual research/critique workload.

second_wave.activation: only if no first-wave 9B candidate clears quality gates
second_wave.placement: exclusive dual-GPU or measured offload mode
second_wave.role: occasional deep-mode comparator, not default resident

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not promote a model from public benchmark scores alone.
Do not compare candidates on different evidence packets or acceptance guards.
Do not silently change context size, reasoning budget, or tool permissions between arms.
Do not use external cloud-model fallback inside a local candidate measurement.

benchmark_suite.principle: Use existing difficult research-engine cases and known failure modes before generic benchmarks.

suites.purpose: Ensure stronger reasoners do not regress existing source-grounded verification behavior.
Test the exact semantic/provenance failures that motivated repeated local-EXTRACT redesign.
Measure structured reasoning/control behavior on preserved semantic-control fixtures.

suites.source_policy: Build frozen offline packets from completed historical research jobs without scientific-state mutation.
Build frozen reviewer/critic packets from previously known blocking defects and accepted corrections.
suites.purpose: Measure false acceptance and issue localization; this does not impose an independent-review gate on experiments.

benchmark_suite.repetition_policy: At least 3 runs for stochastic reasoning arms; deterministic/greedy controls may use one run if byte-stable.

hard_failures: false acceptance on frozen known-negative support/review cases
structured-output contract violation that bypasses fail-closed handling
external LLM/cloud fallback during local-only measurement
scoring.promotion_rule: A first-wave candidate must have zero hard failures on the frozen promotion set, materially improve hard-case/reasoning success over Qwen3.5-4B, and remain within the single-GPU resource envelope. If Qwythos wins, it must beat the official 9B control on workload quality rather than merely the 4B baseline.

gitrunner_execution_plan.action: Validate contract/schema/tests on exact PR head.
Resolve immutable revisions, license/provenance, reproducible quant/runtime artifact identities, and promote read-only offline-complete cache objects.
Load one candidate at a time; verify exact cache/runtime identity; record cold/warm resource receipt.
Run identical frozen evidence packets and inference envelopes sequentially across all first-wave arms.
Run only finalists in a 2400-second autonomous local-only loop with tools/checkpoints and no cloud-model fallback.
Write machine-readable result and select KEEP_4B, PROMOTE_9B_CONTROL, PROMOTE_QWYTHOS_9B, or OPEN_35B_DEEP_MODE.

experimental_architecture.executor_model: single executor may design, implement, run, diagnose, patch, and rerun
required_controls: frozen benchmark contracts before each measurement
no post-result metric/threshold rewriting within a frozen experiment
experimental_architecture.failure_behavior: A failed experiment is evidence. Iterate immediately when the next change is within the frozen research scope.

stop_conditions: install a new long-lived production model owner
promotion_boundary.note: At a promotion boundary, choose assurance proportionate to blast radius. Independent review is optional unless separately required by the governing control-plane task.

explicit_non_authorizations: No new model download or cache promotion.
No automatic independent-review requirement for this experimental tranche.
